findings.evidence: Extension.lean:142 `private theorem dgDifferential_apply` (proved by `simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_zsmul_unit, Pi.sub_apply, …]`). Restrict.lean:192 and :280 contain the identical manual `rw` chain.
findings.fix: Make the entrywise lemmas `dgDifferential_apply`, `dgDifferential_apply_zero` and `dgComp_apply` public, either in Basic.lean or as non-private lemmas in Extension.lean. Then start both proofs with a single rewrite by that lemma.
findings.issue: `dgDifferential_restrictHom` (line 192) and `dgDifferential_toExtensionRestrict` (line 280) both open with the same 13-step `rw` chain (`dgHomEquiv_dgDifferential, map_zero, map_sub, map_add, map_zsmul_unit, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.sub_apply, …`). The chain only re-derives the entrywise twisted differential, which Extension.lean already proves as the private `dgDifferential_apply` and `dgDifferential_apply_zero`. A brittle chain written twice.

findings.evidence: OneSided.lean:309-322 builds `hsingle` via `Fintype.sum_subsingleton … |>.trans (sum_dgComp_proj_single R M)` and then builds `e` by hand. The `Fintype.sum_subsingleton` call at OneSided.lean:311 has no counterpart elsewhere in TauCeti/CategoryTheory/DG.
findings.fix: Add lemmas in AdditiveClosure/Basic.lean: `dgComp_proj_single_of_subsingleton`, and an iso `M ≅ ⟨PUnit, fun _ ↦ M.X i⟩` (or its homotopy-category version). Use them here.
findings.issue: Inside `prop_ofObj_of_subsingleton`, `hsingle` (proj then single is the identity when the summand set is a subsingleton) and the iso `e` between an object of the additive closure and its only summand are additive-closure facts. They are derived inline from `Fintype.sum_subsingleton`, so neither can be reused.

findings.evidence: In the diff: `rw [extensionMap_def, map_add, dgDifferential_dgComp, dgDifferential_dgComp, dgDifferential_dgComp, dgDifferential_extensionFst, …, h]` followed by `simp only […]; abel`.
findings.fix: Rewrite only the targeted `dgComp_assoc`/`h` step with `rw`. Pass the `dgDifferential_*` lemmas, `neg_dgComp` and the zero lemmas to a single `simp only` set, then finish with `abel`.
findings.issue: `dgDifferential_extensionMap` is a 14-lemma `rw` chain. It includes the `dgDifferential_dgComp` rewrite three times in a row and `dgComp_assoc` calls with all arguments spelled out, so it breaks on any rename or reordering of terms.

summary: Two proofs in Restrict.lean repeat by hand an entrywise rewrite that Extension.lean already has as private helpers. A reusable one-summand identity is also hidden inside a proof in OneSided.lean.
